entry.title: Gros-Horloge
entry.note: Native +X runs north-northeast across the clock pavilion from the belfry toward the opposite north abutment; +Z runs east-southeast along Rue du Gros-Horloge toward the cathedral. Exact Q3116957 mapped pavilion way63205872 and Q22952095 belfry way63206189 form the documented ensemble, matching the municipal museum layout and historical measured plan BnF btv1b10050434r. Clock pavilion center is the signed footprint bounds center. Individual projected rooflines are not assumed to be street-level supports. The mapped pavilion is the open span; the wider measured cast includes its jamb/framing. The belfry has its own confirmed identity Q22952095. Adjacent apartment buildings remain outside the model; the small workshop and fountain are part of the landmark. Roof/finial height and ornaments are reconstructed from the cited primary views. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
